column1: # The BO3 remaster's effects the mod ships (tools/bo3_fx.pl), each with every effect it runs. In game they are
# mg/<file name>: mg/fx_alcatraz_blue_flame_loop and so on.
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_blue_flame_loop          # the fireplace's blue flame
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_blue_flame_loop as=fx_mg_barrel_flame spread=0.5   # the drums' flame, held inside their rim (half its sideways spread)
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_blue_flame_flare_up      # the forge's flare-up as the gun is laid down
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_blue_flame_flare_up as=fx_mg_barrel_flare spread=0.5 size=0.75   # a drum refilling the temper, its burst within the rim's width
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_blue_flame_skull         # a lit skull
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_blue_flame_vm            # the tempered gun's flame
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_lockdown_wardens scale=1.0146,1.019   # the office lockdown: one effect outlining the door and walls
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_alcatraz_magmagat_power surface           # the forge powered, turned with the press
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_prison_magmagat_press_fire surface        # the press at work, turned with the press
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_prison_magmagat_aoe surface               # the lava pool, lying on the surface it hit
_copforthat/_zm_prison/fx_prison_magmagat_impact_decal      # the blob's scorch
harry/magmagat/fx_magmagat_trail_bolt                       # the lava blob in flight
harry/magmagat/fx_magmagat_impact                           # the blob landing
harry/magmagat/fx_magmagat_explode                          # the blob bursting
harry/blundersplat/fx_blundersplat_muzzleflash                # the Magmagat's muzzle flash (the remaster's: Harry's fire-coloured Acid Gat flash)
harry/blundersplat/fx_blundersplat_muzzleflash_3p             # the same, seen by others
harry/blundersplat/fx_blundersplat_muzzleflash as=fx_mg_tempered_flash tint=0.3,0.6,1        # the tempered gun's muzzle flash: the same flash burning blue
harry/blundersplat/fx_blundersplat_muzzleflash_3p as=fx_mg_tempered_flash_3p tint=0.3,0.6,1  # the same, seen by others
harry/blundersplat/fx_blundersplat_muzzleflash_ug             # the Magmus Operandi's flash (the remaster's: Harry's _ug)
harry/blundersplat/fx_blundersplat_muzzleflash_ug_3p          # the same, seen by others
